name: Ramsey graphs for R(5,5): large graphs with no K5 and no independent 5-set
description: Construct a graph on as many vertices as possible with no clique of size 5 and no independent set of size 5. Every such graph on n vertices proves R(5,5) > n. The best known construction is Exoo's 42-vertex graph (R(5,5) >= 43) and Angeltveit and McKay proved R(5,5) <= 46, so the exact value is open. The seed is the Paley graph on 37 vertices, verified (5,5)-free by the evaluator.

sources.locator: Angeltveit and McKay, R(5,5) <= 46: the current upper bound and a summary of the lower bound 43 (Exoo 1989).
Radziszowski, Small Ramsey Numbers (dynamic survey): R(5,5) bounds 43..46.

execution.interface: construct() -> (n, edges): the number of vertices and a list of (i, j) pairs with 0 <= i < j < n. The graph must contain no clique of size CLIQUE and no independent set of size INDEPENDENT; n must be at most MAX_VERTICES. Score: n, maximized (each valid graph proves R(CLIQUE, INDEPENDENT) > n).

limitations: Exoo's 42-vertex graph is not embedded; the evaluator only certifies candidate graphs, so the reference label is none.
A valid graph on 43 or more vertices would refute the conjecture R(5,5) = 43 and must be independently verified.
